topics.resolution: Discussed options for reuse; existing 1963 side preferred due to known geotechnical conditions

topics.topic: Comparison to Taylor & Burns design program
topics.resolution: Discussed; Taylor & Burns design had larger allocations than Tony Sculumbrine's efficiency-focused approach
topics.quote: taylor & burns had much larger "usable" square footage for many departments, including numerous conference rooms, waiting areas, and record storage allocations.

topics.resolution: Endorsed 'mean and lean' allocation with centralized shared spaces; agreed to gather employee input using MoSCoW method
topics.quote: tony and others advocated for a "mean and lean" allocation (smaller, efficient departmental areas, centralized/shared conference/meeting spaces rather than dedicated rooms for each department).

topics.resolution: Decided to relocate selectboard and public meetings to Town Hall first floor to improve accessibility
topics.quote: relocating selectboard/public meetings to town hall first floor (improves accessibility vs. current meeting location in ritter which requires using a chairlift for handicapped access).

topics.resolution: Identified as ongoing concern; to be addressed through employee input; digital storage transition possible
topics.quote: committee members expressed concern about reducing departmental storage (records, registry of voters, archive space).

topics.resolution: Discussed; existing 1963 addition side preferred due to known subsurface conditions versus uncertainties on School Street side
topics.quote: question raised whether the addition must be built on the 1963 annex side of ritter or could be on the opposite (school street) side; issues include subsurface conditions and ledge on the non-annex side

topics.topic: Fiscal constraints and town appetite for debt-excluded projects
topics.resolution: Committed to fiscally responsible plan in $4-8M range; rejected $20M+ approach as unlikely to gain town approval
